energy.metaTitle: Energy Cost Reduction & TNB Analysis | Bao Service Malaysia
energy.metaDescription: Data-driven energy cost reduction for industrial and commercial facilities in Malaysia. Free TNB bill analysis, AI-assisted portal insights, full meter data review, and right-sized cost reduction measures.
energy.heroTitle: Reduce energy cost with your actual data
energy.heroSub: A data-driven approach using your real TNB bills and meter data to pinpoint cost reduction—right-sized measures that lower spend without oversizing equipment.
energy.heroAiNote: Connected facilities can also use AI-assisted insights in the Energy Portal to screen opportunities, explain cost drivers, and suggest practical next steps.
energy.heroAudience: Industrial and commercial facilities in Malaysia
energy.tariffEligibilityBody: Our free TNB analysis and cost-reduction programme is built for commercial and industrial accounts on Malaysia’s medium-voltage time-of-use tariff—not domestic or low-voltage rates.
energy.tariffAiNote: For connected accounts, AI-assisted portal insights can help interpret peak/off-peak patterns, demand charges, and meter-level contribution under this tariff class.
energy.tariffCategoryName: Tariff category: Bukan Domestik ToU Voltan Sederhana

energy.evidenceTitle: Bills and reports we work from
energy.evidenceSub: You share TNB bills; we return structured analysis you can act on—and connect to ongoing AI-assisted review where meter data is available.
energy.evidenceAiNote: Bill review and engineering reports form the foundation. When data is connected in the portal, AI can help translate the same inputs into guided questions, ranked priorities, and suggested next actions.
energy.evidenceTnbSub: Tariff class, kW demand, peak/off-peak kWh, and charges.
energy.evidenceTnbAiHint: AI can flag demand spikes, tariff mismatches, and abnormal billing trends for follow-up.
energy.evidenceReportSub: Summary findings, trends, and recommended next steps.
energy.evidenceReportAiHint: Report findings can feed portal Q&A on load shifting, MD reduction, BESS, solar, and retrofit screening.
energy.aiSectionTitle: AI Energy Insights inside the Portal
energy.aiSectionSubtitle: From monitoring data to practical questions, answers, and next actions.
energy.aiSectionHeading: Ask your energy data what to do next
energy.aiSectionBody: Once bills and meter data are connected, the portal helps users move from raw readings to business decisions. The AI layer can review consumption, demand, time-of-use patterns, meter composition, and cost drivers, then suggest where deeper engineering review or cost-reduction action may be required.
energy.aiBenefit1Text: Screen for maximum demand reduction, load shifting, BESS feasibility, solar optimization, and efficiency retrofit potential.
energy.aiBenefit2Text: Break down energy charges, demand charges, peak/off-peak usage, load factor, and abnormal trends in plain language.
energy.aiBenefit3Text: Help management understand whether the next step should be bill review, meter analysis, onsite study, or implementation.
energy.aiBenefit4Text: Create an ongoing digital touchpoint instead of a one-time report, so savings opportunities can be reviewed continuously.
energy.aiPrompt1: Why did my demand charge increase?
energy.aiPrompt2: Which meter drives the highest peak?
energy.aiPrompt3: Can I reduce MD by 100 kW?
energy.aiPrompt4: Is my load profile suitable for BESS?
energy.aiPrompt5: What changed compared with last week?
energy.aiUserQuestion: Can we reduce maximum demand without affecting production?
energy.aiResponse: Your recent load profile shows repeated short peak periods instead of a full-day high-load pattern. This may indicate load shifting or peak shaving potential. Recommended next step: review coincident meter contribution during the demand window and identify flexible loads before proposing equipment changes.
energy.aiDisclaimer: AI insights are used to support engineering review, not replace onsite assessment.
energy.processSub: From your TNB bills to measurable savings—three structured stages, supported by AI-assisted portal insights when your data is connected.
energy.processStep1Desc: We review your TNB bills under Bukan Domestik ToU Voltan Sederhana—tariff, demand, and trends—and share a free report with initial findings.
energy.processStep2Desc: We study main and sub-meter parameters to build an accurate load profile from your facility, not assumptions—ready for AI-assisted pattern screening in the portal.
energy.processStep3Desc: We propose and implement measures matched to your profile, with ongoing portal monitoring and AI-supported review of new savings opportunities after installation.
energy.processAiNote: AI does not replace engineering judgement. It helps teams move faster from data to questions, priorities, and the right next review step.
energy.freeReportSub: Share your recent TNB bills and facility context—we will return a professional summary with no obligation.
energy.freeReportAiNote: Strong candidates for portal AI review are also identified when deeper meter data or ongoing monitoring may add value.
energy.freeReportBullet4: Recommendation on full data analysis if warranted
energy.freeReportBullet5: Indication of whether AI-assisted portal review may help next

timeline.title: What Happens Next
timeline.sub: We treat every pitch seriously — here is how the process works.

step1.title: You submit
step1.body: Share your pitch, links, and where you believe you can create value.

step2.title: We review
step2.body: Our team reads every submission and checks fit against current business needs.

step3.title: Conversation
step3.body: Promising pitches lead to a short call or message exchange.

step4.title: Next steps
step4.body: If there is mutual fit, we discuss collaboration — employment, freelance, or partnership.

faq1.q: Is this a traditional job application?
faq1.a: No. We want you to study our business directions first, then pitch specific value you can create — not send a generic CV blast.

faq2.q: Do I need to tick all three solution chips?
faq2.a: No — but you should understand at least one area well enough to explain where you can help.

faq3.q: What collaboration types do you consider?
faq3.a: Full-time, part-time, freelance, commission-based, internship, and partnership models — depending on the person and the opportunity.

faq4.q: Why do you require an accessible CV link?
faq4.a: Link-based submissions fail when Google Drive or portfolio permissions are restricted. Please set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view".

faq5.q: How long until I hear back?
faq5.a: We aim to review submissions within one to two weeks. Strong, specific pitches may hear back sooner.

faq6.q: Can I apply from outside Singapore?
faq6.a: Yes. Bao Service operates across Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Remote and regional collaboration may be possible depending on the role.
